column1: # Hand-curated SIMBAD oid overrides — residual escape hatch.
# The primary recovery mechanism for components SIMBAD stores under
# non-`WDS J<id><comp>` aliases is the HD/CCDM/HIP cascade in
# refresh-simbad-wds-xids.py's Phase A.6 (auto, no manual list). This
# file exists for residual cases the cascade can't resolve — e.g.
# systems where SIMBAD has the per-component oid but doesn't carry any
# of the cascade's catalog aliases (HD, CCDM-J, HIP) under a recognisable
# `<id><comp>` form.
# Schema (4 tab-separated columns):
#   wds_id        — WDS positional anchor as parsed by parse_wds_summ
#                    (e.g. "06451-1643"). Must match a (wds_id, component)
#                    tuple emitted by split_components(parse_wds_summ).
#   component     — single component letter (e.g. "B"). Same constraint.
#   simbad_oid    — SIMBAD basic.oid integer. The refresh script's Phase B
#                    pulls main_id, Gaia DR3 source_id, and HIP through this
#                    oid via the standard JOIN.
#   reason        — human-readable rationale for the override. Not used by
#                    the script — present so a future maintainer can audit
#                    each row without re-deriving the SIMBAD lookup chain.
# Lines starting with '#' are skipped. Empty lines are skipped. The first
# non-blank, non-comment line is the header.
wds_id
